source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As the Fight phase begins, pick 1 enemy unit this model can see that is within 18" of it. For the rest of the phase, each attack your **KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA** units make against that enemy unit has its Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics improved by 1.
